'''Marek Sierka''' (born 1971) is a [[Theoretical chemistry|theoretical chemist]], Professor of [[Computational materials science|Computational Materials Science]] at the Otto Schott Institute of Materials Research at the [[University of Jena|Friedrich Schiller University Jena]].

== Biography ==
He studied [[chemistry]] and [[physics]] at the [[Jagiellonian University]] (1991–1994), the [[University of Bergen]] (1994–1995) and the [[Humboldt University of Berlin]] (1995–1996).<ref name="unicat">{{cite web| url = https://www.unicat.tu-berlin.de/index1cd0.html| title = Marek Sierka becomes professor at Jena University| date = 4 November 2011| accessdate = 2025-10-30| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20251030135957/https://www.unicat.tu-berlin.de/index1cd0.html| archive-date = 2025-10-30}}</ref> In June 1996 he graduated with a [[Master of Science]] degree in chemistry from the Jagiellonian University. In November 2000 he obtained a [[doctorate]] in chemistry (''[[Latin honors|summa cum laude]]'') from the Humboldt University of Berlin,<ref name="cmsg">{{cite web| url = https://www.cmsg.uni-jena.de/66/prof-dr-marek-sierka| title = Prof. Dr. Marek Sierka| accessdate = 2025-10-30| publisher = cmsg.uni-jena.de| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20250621210027/https://www.cmsg.uni-jena.de/66/prof-dr-marek-sierka| archive-date = 2025-06-21}}</ref> under the supervision of [[Joachim Sauer]].<ref name="unicat" /> In June 2009 he obtained [[habilitation]] in theoretical chemistry from the Humboldt University of Berlin. In October 2009 he was appointed as lecturer at the Humboldt University of Berlin. In September 2011 he was a visiting professor at the Italian Institute of Technology at the National Nanotechnology Laboratories in [[Lecce]]. In 2012 he was appointed Professor of Computational Materials Science
at the Otto Schott Institute of Materials Research at the [[University of Jena|Friedrich Schiller University Jena]].<ref name="cmsg" /><ref name="mareksierkaunicat">{{cite web| url = https://www.unicat.tu-berlin.de/indexe70f.html| title = Prof. Dr. Marek Sierka| publisher = unicat.tu-berlin.de| accessdate = 2025-10-30| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20251030140903/https://www.unicat.tu-berlin.de/indexe70f.html| archive-date = 2025-10-30}}</ref> Between 2016 and 2017 he was a lecturer at the Jagiellonian University.<ref>{{cite web| url = https://chemia.uj.edu.pl/wydzial/aktualnosci/-/journal_content/56_INSTANCE_5c3cCrLN3CVc/41638/117243705| title = 04.03.2016 Seminarium Ogólnowydziałowe| date = March 2016| accessdate = 2025-10-30| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20251030140530/https://chemia.uj.edu.pl/wydzial/aktualnosci/-/journal_content/56_INSTANCE_5c3cCrLN3CVc/41638/117243705| archive-date = 2025-10-30| publisher = chemia.uj.edu.pl}}</ref><ref>{{cite web| url = https://chemia.uj.edu.pl/wydzial/know/zagraniczni-wykladowcy| title = Zagraniczni wykładowcy w latach 2016 - 2017| publisher = chemia.uj.edu.pl| accessdate = 2025-10-30| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20240708010607/https://chemia.uj.edu.pl/wydzial/know/zagraniczni-wykladowcy| archive-date = 2024-07-08}}</ref>

His fields of interest include modeling and atomistic simulations, structure, properties and reactivity of low-dimensional systems (clusters, [[nanoparticle]]s, thin layers, surfaces) as well as methods for global [[structural optimization]] and design of functional materials.<ref name="mareksierkaunicat" /><ref>{{cite web| url = https://www.jcsm.uni-jena.de/en/152/sierka-marek| title = Prof. Dr. Marek Sierka| publisher = jcsm.uni-jena.de| accessdate = 2025-10-30| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20250516015657/https://www.jcsm.uni-jena.de/en/152/sierka-marek| archive-date = 2025-05-16}}</ref> Since 2017 he has been a member of the editorial board of ''[[Materials (journal)|Materials]]''.<ref name="cmsg" /> He was elected a member of the [[German Chemical Society|Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker]] e.V. (GDCh) and the Arbeitsgemeinschaft für Theoretische Chemie (AGTC).<ref name="cmsg" />
